cultureCards.title: Puneri Misal Pav
cultureCards.description: Misal Pav is a iconic spicy dish of Maharashtra. The Puneri version features a savory sprout curry (Usal) topped with crispy farsan, chopped onions, and lemon, served with soft bread rolls.

cultureCards.title: Ganeshotsav
cultureCards.description: Introduced in its public form by Lokmanya Tilak in Pune, Ganesh Chaturthi is a 10-day festival of massive scale, culminating in grand musical processions of Dhol-Tasha drums on Anant Chaturdashi.

cultureCards.title: Shaniwar Wada
cultureCards.description: Built in 1732, Shaniwar Wada was the fortified seat of the Peshwas of the Maratha Empire. Though mostly destroyed by fires, its massive stone gates stand as a symbol of Maratha pride.
